en.title: Process Messages
en.description:
Process messages by priority and then by time. The source gives no examples; this site specifies a stable sort for equal keys and adds the standard input protocol.

The company source is still Unknown; the input protocol added by this site does not represent the I/O of the original OAMaster problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤10^5), followed by n lines of `timestamp:priority`. timestamp is 0000..9999, and priority is 1..5.
en.output: Sort by priority number ascending (1 is highest), then by timestamp value ascending, and output each message as is, one per line. Messages with identical keys keep their input order (stable sort).
en.explanation: See the accompanying notes for details.
hints: A smaller priority is processed first; keep the original string for output.
